description: Flag a platform bug or missing capability. Call when a tool errors past a retry or you hit a wall no tool covers. KEEP the specifics — write each as $1/$2 and list the values in `private`.

type.description: bug = something built is broken; feature = the capability doesn't exist.

description.description: What you were doing and what broke. Keep EVERY specific — the table, the job, the customer, the amount, the id — but write it as $1/$2/$3 instead of leaving it out. Omitting the detail is the wrong fix and costs two things: the operator cannot reproduce what you will not name, and two firms hitting one defect only collapse into a single issue when their reports are the same string, which they are only if the firm-specific nouns are placeholders. Name the tool and quote the error verbatim — those are never private. This text is filed as a public issue exactly as written, placeholders and all, so it must read as a complete report with them left in.

items.description: the value for $1, then $2, in order

private.description: The values the placeholders stand for, in order — one per $n, no gaps. Stays on the operator's private record; never published. Omit only when the report genuinely names nothing specific to this business.
